executiveSummary: Active OT-targeting and perimeter exploitation elevate systemic risk. U.S. Water/Wastewater PLCs are being altered on the public internet, forcing manual ops and boil-water notices. Security Advisory Credential/config leaks tied to 86k+ FortiGate devices enable AD credential theft and VPN abuse-significant IT-to-OT pivot exposure at operators relying on Fortinet edge. Security Advisory Edge appliances and RMMs are under live exploitation: Progress LoadMaster unauth RCE; N-able N-central auth bypass with Cloudflare Tunnel persistence; TeamCity RCE in KEV-each is a potential blast path into OT. CISA KEV View Article Coordinated OT attack in Poland abused a misconfigured private APN to reach turbine and water-treatment controls-an emerging cellular ingress vector CI owners must audit now. Supporting Report Pro-Russia hacktivists continue opportunistic VNC intrusions on HMI/SCADA causing loss of view and parameter changes-eliminate exposed VNC immediately. Security Advisory Actively exploited enterprise apps (Metabase pre-auth admin takeover; GeoServer RCE playbook) threaten data pipelines and GIS platforms often adjacent to OT. View Article Security Advisory EV charging (EVSE) vulnerabilities (unauth RCE over OCPP, local interfaces) present grid-edge disruption potential; segment and update urgently. CISA Bulletin

items: Pro-Russia hacktivists (e.g., CARR, Z-Pentest, NoName057(16), Sector16) opportunistically targeting exposed VNC on HMIs/SCADA with loss-of-view and unsafe parameter changes. Security Advisory
Russian state-supported LAUNDRY BEAR exploiting Zimbra zero-day to mass-exfiltrate mail and establish persistent access in defense/energy/government networks. Security Advisory
OctLurk/SilkLurk espionage toolchains (Central Asia/Syria) with SOCKS5 tunneling, credential theft, and PlugX-credible enterprise-to-OT pivot risk. View Article

descriptions: Initial Access via exposed services: VNC to HMIs (T1133), web app RCE/SQLi on Metabase/GeoServer (T1190).
Abuse of remote services and admin tools: RMM abuse (T1219), VPN auth bypass, ADC command injection (T1190/T1059).
Credential Access and Privilege Escalation: Kerberoasting (T1558.003), AD token abuse, auth bypasses (KEV items), password dumping via DB/resident toolkits.
Command and Control/Evasion: Cloud proxy tunnels (Cloudflare Tunnel), SOCKS proxies (custom), living-off-the-land (BITS, PowerShell), BitB/AitM phishing for session tokens.
Data Exfiltration and Impact: Email/GAL dumps (Zimbra), GIS/DB exfil (GeoServer), parameter changes and lockouts on PLCs/HMIs (ICS: Loss of View/Control).

outlook72h: Patch window: prioritize LoadMaster, N-central (Hotfix 2), TeamCity, Metabase; remove public exposure and apply WAF virtual patches where feasible. Credentials: enterprise-wide rotation for FortiGate-linked accounts/PSKs/certs; revoke suspicious app passwords; enforce MFA on edge/RMM/CI/CD. Exposure reduction: immediate takedown of exposed VNC and any internet-reachable PLC/HMI; run external scans to validate closure. Cellular ingress: emergency audit of private APN configs and 4G/5G routers; block intra-APN east-west and log all APN traffic to OT DMZ sensors. Threat hunt: look for Cloudflare Tunnel services on managed endpoints (N-central persistence), Metabase IoC request pairs, Zimbra SOAP/app password creations, and web shells on GeoServer/Tomcat.
